illager_names.jaymoskingdoms.hint.0: Pillagers keep a place they call %s, %s. I wouldn't go looking.
illager_names.jaymoskingdoms.hint.1: The carters say there is a hold named %s, %s. They go round it.
illager_names.jaymoskingdoms.hint.2: You hear a name from the raiders' mouths sometimes, %s. It lies, they say, %s.
illager_names.jaymoskingdoms.muster.none: The ledger lists no camp near enough to matter.
illager_names.jaymoskingdoms.muster.no_t: No mark yet; the page is left blank there.
illager_names.jaymoskingdoms.standard.bl: The board is carved, but you know no camp it could speak for.
illager_names.jaymoskingdoms.waymark.bla: The carving is worn to nothing.
They say %s is empty now. Nobody buried what came out of it.
The grey coats walk like the old %s company did. Same step. Same banner, near enough.
I knew a man who traded at %s. He says he knows the faces in that column.
